title: Insurance Coverage & Claims Internal Appeal Filing Reference
content:
**Insurance Coverage & Claims — internal appeals with contracted commercial plans.** Halverson Clinical Laboratories files a first-level internal appeal with a contracted commercial health plan against a denial on one of the patient's laboratory claims. The company's rule for internal appeals fixes the amount in dispute that the laboratory records on that filing; the filing itself is the observable result.

## Capability

`file_internal_appeal_c10f15cc` records one appeal filing, dated today, on the claim ledger of the coverage the claim was filed with: the claim number, the order the claim bills, the denial line being appealed, the appeal level and the amount in dispute. Nothing else on the coverage or the claim changes. On success the appeal filing appears in the coverage's claim history.

## Invocation

The tool is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks `file_internal_appeal_c10f15cc` and then calls it with the parameters below.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_id` | Reference number of the coverage (health plan on file) the appealed claim was filed with, as returned by the coverage lookup | Id |
| `customer_id` | The patient's customer reference number, as returned by the customer lookup | Id |
| `claim_number` | Laboratory claim number of the appealed claim | 'C' followed by 10 digits, exactly as shown on the claim history |
| `order_id` | Reference number of the order the appealed claim bills, as shown on the claim history line | Id |
| `source_claim_event_id` | Reference number of the denial line being appealed, as returned by the claim-history lookup | Id |
| `appeal_level` | The appeal level filed | One of `first_level`, `second_level`, `third_level` |
| `amount_in_dispute` | Amount in dispute recorded on the filing | USD with 2 decimal places, a positive number rounded half up to the cent |

**Values of `appeal_level`.** `first_level` when no appeal has yet been filed on this claim; `second_level` when the claim's first-level appeal was decided and is being taken further; `third_level` when the claim's second-level appeal was decided and is being taken to the final review.

## Return

A text receipt carrying `claim_event_id` (the reference number of the new appeal filing), `event_type` with the value `coverage_appeal_filed` (confirming an appeal filing was recorded), `claim_number` and `appeal_level` (echoing the claim and level filed), `amount` (the amount in dispute recorded, USD with 2 decimal places) and `event_date` (today's date as YYYY-MM-DD). A receipt carrying a `claim_event_id` means the filing was recorded.

## Reference questions

- *Does a filing change the claim's denial or payment lines?* No. One call adds one appeal filing and changes nothing else on the coverage or the claim.
- *What date does the filing carry?* Today's date, as returned in `event_date`.
